notes.title: Coloured sections
notes.text: Text on a coloured section is always easy to read. A section takes Material 3’s container of its colour, with the container’s text colour on it, and cards and fields keep their own look. A section with an image puts its text on a solid panel, so any photo works.

notes.title: Text bar shortcut
notes.text: Reaching the text bar no longer takes many Tab presses. Press Alt+F10 in the text or on a selected block to move to the bar, use the arrow keys to move between tools, and press Escape to return. Delete removes a selected block.

notes.title: Theme accessibility
notes.text: You see before you choose a theme whether it is accessible. Open a theme under Themes: it says if it meets WCAG 2.2 AA and lists each part and criterion where it falls short. Your own colors and images are not part of this.
A docked date picker fits a narrow screen, and a search field shows one clear button
A text field with an error shows keyboard focus with a thicker edge, and in a denser theme a tap lands on the control you touch
Buttons, expanding lists, Questions and answers and Checklist have 16 dp side padding, as in Material 3
Cards stand 8 px apart, as in Material 3, in Cards, Price cards, Panels, Image grid and related posts
Choice rows in lists of radio buttons have Material 3’s 16 px side padding
Density has Medium and Small only, as Material 3 has no step above Medium, and an account set to Large becomes Medium
Keyboard focus rings on the site use Material 3’s secondary colour, 3 px thick
Lists in the start screen's cards keep the card's padding, and the title lines up with the rows
Menus in the editor work with the keyboard: use the arrow keys, Home, End and a letter to move, and Escape to close and go back to the button
On a computer, the search view dims the page behind it, as in Material 3
Press Tab once in the editor to show Skip to content, and Enter to jump over the navigation to the screen’s content
Search bars, bars and date pickers lose their shadow, as Material 3 draws them, while menus, dialogs and floating buttons keep theirs
Segmented lists sit on the page’s surface, as in Material 3
Small icon buttons, switch icons, slider tracks, list rows and spaces between buttons now have Material 3’s sizes and shapes
The editor's menu rail has the colour of Material 3's navigation rail
The icon button inside a filled button shows its keyboard focus ring in the button’s text colour, so you can see it
The main menu casts a shadow when it opens over the page, as in Material 3
The main menu is wider on a phone, with its close button at the end and a line under its head
The menu drawer’s shade over the page takes a tint of your site’s colours
The menu's header is a standard list item with your avatar, name and site address, and the close button at its end
The screen title no longer shows a focus ring when a screen opens or after a refresh on a phone
The search field shows its focus ring only when you use the keyboard, not after a click or a tap
Themes and apps can give an element an elevation level with the classes mo-elevation-0 to mo-elevation-3 and mo-elevated-1 to mo-elevated-3
Tonal buttons, outlined edges, menus, sliders and switches use Material 3's colours
